title: Ethio Telecom plants 250,000 seedlings as part of 'Green Legacy' campaign
desc: Ethio Telecom has launched its eighth nationwide Green Legacy campaign, planting 250,000 more seedlings while showcasing a sustainability strategy covering power for telecom infrastructure from renewable sources, electric mobility, and energy-efficient digital networks. The scheme was launched simultaneously in Addis Ababa and the operator's eighteen regional offices under the national 'Planting Hope' campaign and Ethio Telecom's 'For a Green Ethiopia' project, uniting over 3,500 employees and partners.
